name: @domos/ui
description: Temporary compatibility bridge for OwlLayer AI UI from @domos/ui to @owllayer/ui

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @owllayer/ui build && tsup src/index.ts src/dashboard.ts src/devtools.ts --format esm --dts --clean --external @owllayer/ui
scripts.test: pnpm build && node --input-type=module -e "import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url); for (const specifier of ['@domos/ui', '@domos/ui/dashboard', '@domos/ui/devtools']) require.resolve(specifier); const modules = await Promise.all([import('./dist/index.js'), import('./dist/dashboard.js'), import('./dist/devtools.js')]); const checks = [[modules[0], ['mountDashboard', 'mountDevTools']], [modules[1], ['mountDashboard']], [modules[2], ['mountDevTools']]]; for (const [mod, names] of checks) for (const name of names) if (typeof mod[name] !== 'function') throw new Error('Missing compatibility export: ' + name);"
